blueprint.label: Platform: 32 railguns, 32 gun turrets, 1 thruster, 8 cargo bays
blueprint.description: Railguns across the front for big and huge asteroids only, gun turrets behind them for the rest, thrusters at the back, the hub in the middle (the blueprint's origin is the hub's centre). Supply power, railgun ammo, magazines and thruster fuel and oxidizer. With construction-robotics researched the hub rebuilds what asteroids destroy from its stock: fill the bays with spare turrets, poles and foundation, which goes fastest.
